mapper.sql: r.owner_id,r.id,r.source_id,r.target_id,r.relation_type AS type, s.kind AS source_kind,s.status AS source_status,t.kind AS target_kind,t.status AS target_status
FROM knowledge_relation r JOIN knowledge_item s ON s.owner_id=r.owner_id AND s.id=r.source_id JOIN knowledge_item t ON t.owner_id=r.owner_id AND t.id=r.target_id
mapper.select: SELECT WHERE r.owner_id=#{owner} AND r.source_id=#{sourceId} AND r.target_id=#{targetId} AND r.relation_type=#{type}

SELECT v.owner_id,v.item_id,v.id AS version_id,v.version_number AS number,v.title, i.kind,i.status,i.current_version_id FROM knowledge_version v JOIN knowledge_item i ON i.owner_id=v.owner_id AND i.id=v.item_id WHERE v.owner_id=#{owner} AND v.item_id=#{itemId} AND v.id=#{versionId}

SELECT owner_id,id,relation_id,source_id,target_id,relation_type AS type,origin,reason,source_count,task_id,candidate_id,created_at FROM knowledge_relation_supplement WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND id=#{id}
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_relation_supplement WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND relation_id=#{relationId})

SELECT s.owner_id,s.supplement_id,s.ordinal,s.source_item_id AS item_id,s.source_version_id AS version_id, s.source_version_number AS number,s.source_title AS title,s.source_kind AS kind, v.version_number AS actual_number,v.title AS actual_title,i.kind AS actual_kind, i.status AS actual_status,i.current_version_id FROM knowledge_relation_supplement_source s LEFT JOIN knowledge_version v ON v.owner_id=s.owner_id AND v.item_id=s.source_item_id AND v.id=s.source_version_id LEFT JOIN knowledge_item i ON i.owner_id=s.owner_id AND i.id=s.source_item_id WHERE s.owner_id=#{owner} AND s.supplement_id=#{supplementId} ORDER BY s.ordinal
